title: Clear auxiliary relations from a localized kernel equality
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime ideal and R_p its localization [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let D be an R_p-algebra with compatible R-algebra structure and let P be a submersive presentation of D on n+m variables and c equations [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra]. Suppose f is a family of c polynomials over R such that the extension of (f) to R_p[x_1,…,x_{n+m}] equals the kernel of evaluation at P.val. For any family g of t polynomials in the first n variables whose evaluations at the first n values of P are zero, there exist s_j ∈ R \\ p such that C(s_j) times the renamed g_j belongs to (f) for each j. The polynomial rings and renaming are those of [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07F9 (lemma-delocalize-weak), lines 2179–2188, clearing the equations, inverse determinant, and relations

proof.text: For each j, coefficient extension and renaming commute with evaluation (MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap and MvPolynomial.aeval_rename), so the extended renamed g_j is in the kernel. Rewrite the given kernel equality to get membership in the extended ideal (f).

MvPolynomial.isLocalization gives localization at the constants from p.primeCompl; its proof uses polynomial scalar extension and localization base change. Apply IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff to obtain a denominator in that submonoid whose product with the renamed g_j is in (f). Unpack membership in the image submonoid to write the denominator as C(s_j), with s_j outside p. Choose these witnesses for all j; for t=0 the assertion is vacuous.

theorem exists_cleared_submersive_relations
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    {D : Type v} [CommRing D] [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) D]
    [Algebra R D] [IsScalarTower R (Localization.AtPrime p) D]
    (n m c t : ℕ)
    (P : SubmersivePresentation (Localization.AtPrime p) D
      (Fin (n + m)) (Fin c))
    (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + m)) R)
    (hkernel : Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p)))
      (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) = RingHom.ker (aeval P.val))
    (g : Fin t → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (hg : ∀ j, aeval (fun i : Fin n ↦ P.val (Fin.castAdd m i)) (g j) = 0) :
    ∃ (s : Fin t → R),
      (∀ j, s j ∉ p) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin t, MvPolynomial.C (s j) *
        rename (Fin.castLE (Nat.le_add_right n m)) (g j) ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
